Showroom and contact

Visit the Bonnyrigg Tiles showroom in South West Sydney

This is the tile showroom Sydney homeowners, tilers and builders come to for tiles, bathroomware, tapware and trade supplies. Call us, send a message or come and see the tiles in person. We are open Monday to Saturday, with a team who can help you choose tiles, match colours and work out how much to order.

Find us

A tile showroom in south west Sydney

You will find us in Bonnyrigg (Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177), a short drive from Fairfield, Cabramatta, Liverpool, Wetherill Park and Smithfield. Customers come to us from right across Sydney, and we deliver across Sydney metro.

Coming to pick up an order? Have a read of our vehicle loading policy before you set off.

Get directions

Getting here

How to find us and where to park

Bonnyrigg Tiles is in Bonnyrigg, in Sydney's south west, a short drive from Fairfield, Cabramatta, Liverpool, Wetherill Park and Smithfield. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177. Use the Get directions button on this page for a route from your suburb.

Collecting a large order or bringing a trailer? Call (02) 8786 0288 before you set off and the team will tell you where to pull in and load.

When to visit

Showroom opening hours

The Bonnyrigg Tiles showroom is open six days a week and closed on Sundays. We open at 7am so tilers and builders can load before they head to site.

In the showroom

What is on display in the showroom

The showroom is where you compare our tile ranges side by side, including the BT Specials we import ourselves, in marble, stone, travertine and concrete looks. Colour and texture are hard to judge on a screen, so this is the place to see floor and wall tiles in person before you order.

Bring your samples or photos for a free colour consultation, and ask the team about bathroomware, tapware and kitchen sinks to match. If you are renovating a bathroom in Sydney, bring your plans to the showroom and the team will help you match the tiles with bathroomware and tapware. The Clearance Sale is sold in the showroom only. Not ready to visit yet? You can see the tile in a room first.

Where our customers come from

Sydney suburbs we supply from Bonnyrigg

We are a tile shop in Bonnyrigg with one showroom, and we supply customers across Sydney from it. Many come from nearby Fairfield, Cabramatta, Liverpool, Wetherill Park and Smithfield, and we deliver across Sydney metro.

If you are looking for tiles near Liverpool NSW or Wetherill Park, or a tile shop near Fairfield, we are a short drive away. Include your suburb when you send your enquiry and our team will confirm delivery to your area. Our FAQs cover more delivery and pick-up questions.

Collecting an order

Loading tiles and trade pick-up

Orders are collected from the Bonnyrigg showroom, and our vehicle loading policy explains how collection and loading work. Tiles are heavy, so check what your vehicle can carry before you come.

Tilers and builders can pick up trade supplies for tilers, including adhesive, grout, waterproofing, trims and tools, from 7am Monday to Saturday.

Who we are

A family-owned showroom, under current management since 2017

Bonnyrigg Tiles is a family-owned tile shop in south west Sydney, under current management since 2017. We run one showroom, in Bonnyrigg, and supply homeowners, builders, tilers and designers across Sydney from it.

Before you get in touch

Quick answers

When is the showroom open?

Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. We are closed on Sundays.

Can I enquire about several products at once?

Yes. Add tiles, bathroom ware, tapware and supplies to your enquiry cart as you browse, then send them all to us in one enquiry. No payment is taken online.

Do you offer a colour consultation?

Yes, and it is free. Bring your samples or photos to the showroom and our team will help you match tiles, tones and finishes.

Do you deliver?

You can pick up from our Bonnyrigg showroom or have your order delivered across Sydney metro. Let us know which you prefer when you send your enquiry.

I am a builder or tiler. Can you supply my jobs?

Yes. We supply tiles, adhesive, grout, waterproofing, trims and tools from the one showroom, and we open at 7am. Call (02) 8786 0288 to talk through what you need.

Do I need an appointment to visit the tile showroom?

No. You are welcome to walk in during opening hours, Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm. If you would like a free colour consultation, call (02) 8786 0288 first so the team can set time aside for you.

Can I take tile samples home?

Ask the team in the showroom. What can be taken home differs from range to range, so call (02) 8786 0288 to check a specific tile before you visit.

Do you deliver tiles across Sydney?

Yes, we deliver across Sydney metro. Include your suburb when you send your enquiry and our team will confirm delivery to your area. You can also collect from the Bonnyrigg showroom.

Is there parking and trailer access at the showroom?

Customers collect orders from the showroom, and our vehicle loading policy explains how loading works. If you are bringing a trailer or collecting a large order, call (02) 8786 0288 before you set off so the team can tell you where to pull in.

Can tilers and builders pick up trade supplies the same day?

Trade supplies are sold from the showroom, which opens at 7am Monday to Saturday. Stock moves quickly, so call (02) 8786 0288 to confirm what you need is on the shelf before you drive over.
